description:
FILED s516b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-12).  #3241 made the board's PASS mean "plan met + SBCL exit 0" and gave every short file ONE `*PLAN*` row (`ran M of N, rc R`).  These eleven had no row before; each is blessed under THIS task until its cause is read -- split each off into its own task (or cite an existing one) as it is probed.  What is known (b2 = the s516b tree, 0de6568e; "died" = the last stderr line of `tools/run-dist-t.pl DIST t/FILE`):

  Algorithm-Diff oo.t          ran 122 of 969, rc 2   (rows 111 121 122 fail first; base read PARTIAL 102/20)
  Capture-Tiny 07-stderr-closed.t  ran 1 of no plan, rc 1  died: "A nested error within --disable-debugger error handling"
  Class-Method-Modifiers 041-modify-parent.t  ran 1 of no plan, rc 1  died: an unhandled simple-error at a top-level form
  Data-Dump dump.t             ran 36 of 38, rc 1     died: an unhandled TYPE error "Value of pcl::h in ..." (a raw CL error, rule 12)
  JSON-PP 019_incr.t           ran 384 of 745, rc 255 (last row "tailws"; base read PASS 384/0)
  Path-Tiny filesystem.t       ran 1 of no plan, rc 2  died: "Error open (<) on '/tmp/XXXX': No such file or directory"
  Path-Tiny sig_die.t          ran 1 of no plan, rc 2  died: the same open error on a tempfile
  Role-Tiny subclass.t         ran 5 of no plan, rc 2  died: "Can't locate CreateMITest/Bottom.pm in @INC"
  Scalar-List-Utils uniqnum.t  ran 20 of 23, rc 255
  Try-Tiny context.t           ran 13 of 25, rc 0     (stops after "Proper context VOID in catch{}"; base read PASS 13/0)
  Try-Tiny finally.t           ran 15 of 30, rc 0     (stops after row 15 "finally ran", which fails: expected to match "fin 3 at")

Outputs of the probes: scratch/s516b/pr/run-*.out in the s516b worktree.

=== DONE (s518d, commits 1c5fc078 + the re-cause edit after it) ===
Data-Dump dump.t had already left.  The other ten, run alone (tools/run-dist-t.pl; perl for the oracle), outputs in the s518d worktree scratch/s518d/rd/:
| file | ran/planned | cause | action |
| Algorithm-Diff oo.t | 122/969 rc 2 | the hunk iterator croak "Get: Invalid request (min1)" escapes an eval {} | cite #1511 A |
| Capture-Tiny 07-stderr-closed.t | 1/no plan rc 1 | `defined fileno STDERR` true on a closed STDERR (fixed, #3371), then a _close EBADF | FIXED #3371 (1c5fc078); cite #3372 |
| Class-Method-Modifiers 041-modify-parent.t | 1/no plan rc 1 | raw SBCL FINALIZE-INHERITANCE on a forward-referenced class | new #3373 |
| JSON-PP 019_incr.t | 384/745 rc 255 | s/// on the lvalue sub incr_text | cite NS:Lvalue subroutines (#930) |
| Path-Tiny filesystem.t | 1/no plan rc 2 | while-condition `my` is one variable; closures see the last value (openw opens "<") | new #3374 (silent wrong) |
| Path-Tiny sig_die.t | 1/no plan rc 2 | same | #3374 |
| Role-Tiny subclass.t | 5/no plan rc 2 | stash snapshot holds subs only; an @ISA-only package reads unloaded | cite NS:Live symbol-table hashes |
| Scalar-List-Utils uniqnum.t | 20/23 rc 255 | `my $x = EXPR for LIST;` dies "Bug. Fell through" | new #3375 |
| Try-Tiny context.t | 13/25 rc 0 | the dist's own DESTROY-guard Try::Tiny: no finally runs | cite NS:DESTROY + #2370 |
| Try-Tiny finally.t | 15/30 rc 0 | same | cite NS:DESTROY + #2370 |
No blessed row cites #3284 now.
subject: QUEUE: the board's *PLAN* rows the #3241 verdict surfaced whose cause is not yet read (11 files in 8 dists: a file that stops short of its plan or exits non-zero, which used to read PASS/PARTIAL with no row)
